description: Rebuild the PROJECTS page (src/app/projects/page.tsx) as the prototype's hero + bento grid, and the SERVICES page (src/app/services/page.tsx) as the prototype's hero (chip-drift emoji) + 2x2 service cards with checklists + reversed tech marquee + industries grid. Depends on FEAT-001 (tokens/motion/chrome) and shares patterns with FEAT-002 (marquee, cards, placeholders). All new CSS in globals.css. These two pages are independent of each other and of about/contact.
steps: PROJECTS hero: eyebrow 'Our work', h1 (Space Grotesk) 'Products built for ' + <em accent> 'real operations.', sub 'AI systems, marketplaces, business platforms, and customer experiences designed to solve substantial problems.'

PROJECTS bento grid: grid 4 cols, grid-auto-rows 220px, gap clamp(14px,2vw,22px). 8
tiles with span variations, each a decorative gradient placeholder block (NO to missing project-*.webp) with a data-parallax-img-styled inner layer (aria-hidden) + a bottom gradient overlay linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 45%, oklch(0.16 0.004 285/0.82)) carrying a white '0N' index + h3 title. Tiles (reuse src/content/projects.ts slugs where they map, link to /projects/): (span2 row2) 'AI-Based Software for Luxury Car Dealers' -> luxury-car-dealer-software; (span2) 'Investigative Case Management Software' -> investigative-case-management; (span1) 'Luxury eCommerce Platform' -> luxury-ecommerce-platform; (span1) 'Senior Engagement Platform' -> senior-engagement-platform; (span2) 'Multi-Vendor eCommerce Marketplace' -> multi-vendor-ecommerce-marketplace; (span2 row2) 'Food & Grocery Delivery App' -> food-grocery-delivery-app; (span1) 'CMA Report Generation Software' -> cma-report-generation-software; (span1) 'Recruitment Platform' -> recruitment-platform. Give each tile a distinct pastel gradient (rotate the four prototype pastels). Keep a visible-data disclosure if implying results. The existing ProjectsGallery/WorkCard components may be left unused for this page or reused if convenient, but the prototype bento layout is the target.

SERVICES hero: position relative; a floating decorative span (the prototype uses a brain emoji) top-right animating chip-drift 6s (aria-hidden, gated by html[data-js]/reduced-motion). eyebrow 'Services', h1 'Apps, websites, ' + <em accent> 'AI and more.', sub 'End-to-end product engineering that turns complex ideas into secure, useful, scalable systems.'

SERVICES 2x2 service cards: grid of 4 cards (border radius 18 bg #fff), each: media aspect 16/9 as a distinct pastel gradient placeholder (NO to missing service-*.webp/png), body with '0N' index, h3, p, and a 2-col checklist
    of items each prefixed with a check glyph. Source names/summary/items from src/content/services.ts serviceCategories (they already contain the four categories and item lists). Use the prototype's shorter card copy where it differs, but the existing serviceCategories.items are a good fit: 01 AI & ML [Predictive Analytics / NLP & Conversational AI / Computer Vision / Generative Models]; 02 Web / Mobile App / SaaS [Web App Development / Mobile App Development / Custom SaaS / Workflow Automation]; 03 E-commerce [Multi-Vendor Marketplace / AI Personalization / Subscription Billing / Storefront UI/UX]; 04 Cloud [Cloud Migration / Cloud-Native Apps / Security & Compliance / Disaster Recovery]. Keep card ids (ai-ml, web-mobile-saas, ecommerce, cloud) so /services# deep links from the home expertise/services still resolve.

SERVICES reversed tech marquee: eyebrow 'Platforms & partners', h2 'A modern technology toolkit.' A marquee like FEAT-002 but animation marquee-scroll 22s linear infinite reverse, 5 text-wordmark items (Langchain, Python, OpenAI, Tensorflow, Kafka). Text wordmarks only (no missing logo ), two tracks with the 2nd aria-hidden, decorative aria-hidden with a visually-hidden name list.

SERVICES industries: eyebrow 'Industries', h2 'Solutions grounded in context.' 4-col grid of 8 bordered tiles, each with a '0N' index, a name and a short descriptor: 01 Healthcare 'Telemedicine, EHR, patient management'; 02 Fintech 'Digital payments, mobile banking'; 03 Logistics 'Delivery, fleet, route optimization'; 04 Retail 'POS, inventory, loyalty programs'; 05 Ecommerce 'Marketplaces, B2B & B2C stores'; 06 Education 'LMS, virtual classrooms, AI tutoring'; 07 BFSI Solutions 'Core banking, loan origination'; 08 Real Estate 'Property management, virtual tours'. You may derive names from src/content/industries.ts (first 8) and add the short descriptors as prototype copy (add a descriptor field to industries.ts or a local map). Keep copy check:copy-clean.

Keep the existing page metadata (pageMeta) for both routes. Add all new .projects-* / .services-* section CSS to globals.css with responsive collapse <=820px (bento -> 1-2 cols, service cards -> 1 col, industries 4 -> 2 cols). Ensure [data-reveal]/[data-parallax-img] hooks match the FEAT-001 motion module.
acceptance_criteria: src/app/projects/page.tsx renders the prototype hero + an 8-tile bento grid with span variations, index overlays, titles, links to real /projects/<slug> routes, and gradient placeholders (no missing-image srcs).

src/app/services/page.tsx renders the prototype hero (chip-drift decorative accent), 2x2 service cards with 2-col checklists (ids ai-ml/web-mobile-saas/ecommerce/cloud preserved), a reversed tech marquee, and an 8-tile industries grid with descriptors.
No /Image src points to a nonexistent asset; marquee and card imagery are text/inline-SVG/gradient placeholders; decorative visuals aria-hidden.
Headings use Space Grotesk, body uses DM Sans; colors use the oklch tokens.
verification: Read both page files; confirm all links resolve to existing /projects/[slug] slugs from src/content/projects.ts and no missing-asset srcs.
grep -R 'service-.*\.\(webp\|png\)\|project-.*\.webp\|tech-.*\.png' src/ returns no src usages.
Confirm service card ids ai-ml/web-mobile-saas/ecommerce/cloud still exist for deep links.
If deps install: unset NODE_OPTIONS && npm run build && npm run lint
findings: Rebuilt src/app/projects/page.tsx (prototype hero + 8-tile bento grid, 4 cols / grid-auto-rows 220px, span1/span2/span2row2 variations, four rotating pastel gradients, [data-parallax-img] inner layer aria-hidden, bottom gradient overlay linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 45%,oklch(0.16 0.004 285/0.82)) carrying white 0N index + h3, each tile Links to a real /projects/). Removed the old ProjectsGallery/WorkCard/projects.css imports; projects.css is now an unused file (left in place, not imported). Rebuilt src/app/services/page.tsx (prototype hero with a chip-drift decorative brain emoji gated by html[data-js]/reduced-motion, eyebrow Services, h1 'Apps, websites, ' + AI and more.; 2x2 service cards sourced from serviceCategories with ids ai-ml/web-mobile-saas/ecommerce/cloud preserved for /services# deep links, pastel gradient media placeholders, 0N index, h3, shortened prototype summary, 2-col check-glyph checklist using shortened prototype item copy; reversed tech marquee marquee-scroll 22s linear infinite reverse with 5 text wordmarks (Langchain, Python, OpenAI, Tensorflow, Kafka) across two tracks (2nd aria-hidden) plus a visually-hidden name list; 8-tile industries grid, first 7 names derived from industries.ts then Real Estate for slot 08 per prototype, each with 0N + name + short descriptor). All new .projects-*/.services-* CSS added to globals.css between the FEAT-002 end marker and .shell, with responsive collapse (<=820px: bento -> 2 cols, service cards -> 1 col, industries -> 2 cols; <=520px: bento -> 1 col). No /Image/video srcs to missing assets (all placeholders are CSS gradients / emoji / text wordmarks, decorative visuals aria-hidden). Verification run: `unset NODE_OPTIONS && node scripts/check-copy.mjs src` passed (32 files). Confirmed all 8 project slugs exist in src/content/projects.ts, the /projects/[slug] route exists, service card ids are intact, and grep for service-*.webp|png / project-*.webp / tech-*.png src usages returned none. next build/lint/e2e not runnable in-sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, node_modules not installed) per context.json; correct-by-construction.
